_meta.what_this_is: A toy secret and the alphabet its characters are drawn from, for demonstrating a timing side channel in secret comparison. The attack recovers the secret one character at a time by measuring how many characters a comparison examines before returning -- a deterministic stand-in for how long the comparison takes. A real attacker measures wall-clock time; the vulnerability and the fix are identical.
_meta.secret_is: A FIXTURE. Short and low-entropy so the character-at-a-time attack runs fast and visibly; the length and alphabet do not change the lesson. Never hard-code a real secret; load it from the environment or a vault.
_meta.format: secret (string); alphabet (the characters guesses are drawn from)
